headline: Google's Gemini reaches 1 billion users, fastest product adoption ever
body: Google announced that Gemini has reached 1 billion users faster than any product in the company's history, signaling massive market penetration for AI assistants. For healthcare AI specifically, this scale matters because it normalizes conversational AI as a primary interface, potentially shifting expectations for clinical decision support and EHR integration. Healthcare organizations will face vendor pressure to match Gemini's capabilities while navigating hallucination risks that remain problematic in medical contexts. The healthcare consulting and IT landscape must now account for how clinicians will expect enterprise AI tools to perform at consumer-grade speeds and accessibility levels.
